context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss on talent strategy
purpose: Teach: 申込み/選抜/院長/アナリスト/アドバイザー/部数/直行/配備

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 人材は申込みの段階で、見抜けるものだ。
lines.en: Talent reveals itself at the application stage — if you're looking.
lines.style: Measured, patient pause before the opening word. Quiet conviction. Light touch on the key phrase. Not lecturing — observing from long experience. Breathing room between thoughts.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。選抜も真摯に、院長クラスの目利きをお願いしています。
lines.en: Yes. I take selection seriously — we're asking for director-level discernment.
lines.style: Respectful but firm. Slight emphasis on 'seriously' — showing he understands the weight. Clear-eyed, not defensive. The tone of someone reporting back to someone they respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 外部アナリスト、アドバイザーの活用、惜しまずやれ。
lines.en: Don't hesitate on external analysts and advisors. Use them fully.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Light accent on 'don't hesitate' — permission disguised as instruction. Brief, economical phrasing. The counsel of someone who's seen what corners cost.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 承知しました。部数管理も併せて見直します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll review our print-run management at the same time.
lines.style: Clipped, respectful acknowledgment. No elaboration — just confirmation of receipt and next action. Shows he's listening and already thinking forward. Professional focus.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 地方配備は直行で動かせ。時間が金だ。
lines.en: Local deployment — move it straight through. Time converts to money.
lines.style: Sharp, almost clipped. No softening. Real pressure under the surface without raised volume. The finality of someone who's watched time waste. Brief hold before the last phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Quiet, genuine acceptance. Not performative solemnity — a real moment of taking something in. Slight nod in the voice. Simple because the commitment is real.
